note: Reads each run's sealed `run.json` from `outputs/train001/runs` (balanced, archive_weighted) and `outputs/train002/runs` (dose_omitted, archive_only), checks its SHA-256 against the run hash in the TRAIN-002 model registry, and writes the curves to a tracked manifest so `reporting` can plot them on a fresh clone. Training loss is the arm's own weighted objective on its 64-rollout batch (logged every 10 updates), so its level is not comparable across arms with different data or weights. Validation is equal-weight terminal two-step latent MSE on the 120 TRAIN-001 validation families (every 250 updates). No model is run and no sealed file is written.
